recent_posts.title: The Flutter News Toolkit Finds a New Home at Very Good Ventures
recent_posts.summary: Very Good Ventures has taken over maintenance of the Flutter News Toolkit from Google's Flutter team. The toolkit helps news publishers build Flutter-powered mobile apps quickly with a modern, performant, open-source foundation. VGV plans to maintain stability, support contributors, and keep the project aligned with the Flutter ecosystem while continuing its mission to help publishers deliver quality news experiences.

recent_posts.title: Flutter for Enterprises: Everything CTOs and Engineering Leaders Need to Know
recent_posts.summary: Flutter is a Google-backed, open-source UI framework that enables enterprises to build high-performance applications across mobile, web, desktop, and embedded devices from a single codebase. Companies using Flutter report up to 2x productivity gains, 62% faster time-to-market, and significant cost reductions compared to maintaining separate native teams. Unlike other cross-platform solutions, Flutter compiles directly to machine code for native performance without bridges, offers pixel-perfect design control, and is backed by a mature ecosystem. Major organizations including Google, Toyota, BMW, and Disney use Flutter in production. The framework represents a strategic shift that unifies engineering teams, reduces technical debt, and accelerates feature delivery while maintaining consistent brand experiences across all platforms.

recent_posts.title: Fluttercon EU 2025 recap: technical sessions and community highlights from Berlin
recent_posts.summary: Fluttercon EU 2025 in Berlin became the largest event in the conference's history, bringing together developers and companies from across Europe. Very Good Ventures showcased VGV World—an interactive game built with Flutter, Firebase, and AI—and delivered multiple technical sessions covering CustomPainter for custom graphics, code assessment methodologies, ScrollView internals, and building full-stack apps with Dart Frog for Apple Wallet passes. The event featured a keynote on building a trackside VIP experience for Trackhouse Entertainment Group and concluded with a community after party. Next year, the conference will merge with Droidcon to become Next.App DevCon, uniting six mobile ecosystems.

recent_posts.title: A Very Good Hacktoberfest
recent_posts.summary: Very Good Ventures announces their participation in Hacktoberfest 2025, inviting developers to contribute to their open source projects including Very Good CLI (project templates and utilities), Very Good Templates (template library), and Very Good Workflows (GitHub Actions collection). The company provides guidance on how to get started with contributions, emphasizing issues labeled 'Good First' for newcomers and encouraging collaboration through pull requests.

recent_posts.title: BrazeAI introduces autonomous agents for scalable customer personalization
recent_posts.summary: BrazeAI introduces autonomous agents and decisioning tools that enable marketers to deliver 1:1 personalization at scale. The platform combines AI decisioning studio, agent console, and operator capabilities to optimize campaigns across channels, content, timing, and frequency using first-party data. Success requires three critical factors: maintaining high data quality, establishing cross-functional alignment on metrics before deployment, and starting with small user subsets to allow AI models to mature through continuous learning.

recent_posts.title: Mastering Scalable Theming for Custom Widgets
recent_posts.summary: Learn how to build scalable theming systems for custom Flutter widgets using ThemeExtension, WidgetStates, and WidgetStateProperty. The guide covers separating style from behavior, creating reusable style classes, integrating custom themes into Flutter's theming system, and handling dynamic widget states for interactive components. Includes practical examples and best practices for maintaining consistent visual design across Flutter applications.

recent_posts.title: The Value of Community, Code, & Collaboration
recent_posts.summary: Very Good Ventures sponsored FlutterConf Latam 2025 in Quito, Ecuador, where they showcased technical talks on CustomPainter, UI regression testing, and theming. The company introduced VGV World, an interactive Flutter game with AI integration, and highlighted the growing Latin American Flutter community through networking events and collaborative activities.

recent_posts.title: Andrew Brogdon on AI, DevRel, and the Future of Apps
recent_posts.summary: Andrew Brogdon, Staff Developer Relations Engineer at Google, discusses how AI is transforming developer relations and app development. He explores agentic apps that use AI agents to think and act autonomously, the evolution of programming languages like Dart in an AI-first world, and how DevRel professionals must now consider upskilling AI agents alongside human developers. The conversation highlights the need for engineering leaders to build workflows and cultures ready for human-AI collaboration.

recent_posts.title: Elevating Flutter Test Reports with Allure
recent_posts.summary: Very Good Ventures built a custom Allure integration for Flutter UI testing to generate visual, structured test reports that are accessible to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. The solution addresses limitations in existing Flutter testing frameworks by creating a framework-agnostic TestResults class that captures test execution data and exports it in Allure-compatible JSON format. The approach enables step-by-step test breakdowns, clear failure reporting, and shareable HTML reports that improve team collaboration and decision-making.

recent_posts.title: Server driven UI eliminates app store delays and enables instant mobile updates
recent_posts.summary: Server Driven UI (SDUI) allows mobile apps to receive UI definitions from servers instead of hardcoding them in the app, enabling instant updates without app store approvals. This approach eliminates deployment bottlenecks, enables real-time personalization and A/B testing, and gives teams the flexibility to iterate quickly. Companies like NuBank use SDUI for 70% of new screens, achieving instant updates and independent team deployments. Tools like Remote Flutter Widgets, Swap, and Stac make implementation accessible, though SDUI works best for flexible content areas rather than animation-heavy or offline-critical features.
